text:
**Best all-in-one kit for most van lifers: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200W solar panel.** It has a 2,073.6Wh LiFePO₄ battery—enough, according to the listing, for a 12V fridge and laptop for roughly three days or more, depending on use. The kit is listed at $1,199, with a promotional code noted on the seller’s page. [See the kit and offer](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit); [read the kit overview](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-for-van-life).

One trade-off: the included panel is 200W, and the listing says charging from the car socket is only about 96W. If you’re often driving and want faster alternator charging, factor that into your setup.

If keeping weight down matters more than getting a bundled panel, the [Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2](https://powersized.com/best/rv/) is a strong alternative: the guide lists it at 24.9 lb with up to 600W solar input, though it’s not presented there as a panel-included kit.

judge.top_pick: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W Solar Panel Kit
products: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W Solar Panel Kit
judge.why: The answer's top pick is our BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W kit, with its specs, price and links taken from dealectric.com; the Anker alternative cites powersized.com, and no concern was given.
